item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera stirs a spoonful of sugar into a glass of water until no sugar grains can be seen, yet the water still tastes sweet. Which statement best explains what has happened to the sugar?

options.A: The sugar particles have disappeared, and only the sweetness is left in the water.
options.B: The sugar particles have separated and spread into the spaces between the water particles, so sugar is present throughout the water.
options.C: The sugar has melted into liquid sugar, which sits at the bottom of the glass.
options.D: Each sugar particle has gone inside a water particle, making the water particles sweet.
